original_test_intent: Cross the approved correctable-error threshold on one mapped PCIe slot and prove the generation-specific leaky-bucket/degradation policy changes the expected registers or link state while the system remains recoverable.
original_method: The FAE identifies the physical slot/root port and current link generation, applies the authoritative BER/window/threshold policy for that generation, records rather than destroys baseline errors, supplies an exact bounded CE injection command/count exceeding threshold by the approved margin, compares decoded bucket/link state and restores the endpoint and BIOS configuration.
manual_activity: The FAE resolves generation-specific settings, physical/register target, injection command and count, decides how to handle a dirty baseline, executes the threshold crossing and owns recovery. The agent may compare immutable before/after registers and link evidence.
required_inputs: PCIe slot/endpoint/root-port BDF to versioned socket/register path
Authoritative BER, time-window, threshold and degradation/re-equalization matrix by PCIe generation
ITP/CScripts version/hash plus exact CE injection command and count above threshold
Decoded pre/post bucket register and expected link/degradation/health oracle
Baseline-error disposition, abort, OOB recovery and BIOS restoration plan
safety_requirements: Preserve dirty baseline evidence; do not assume bare register reads clear status
Derive threshold/count from current generation and approved margin
Abort on wrong target, fatal escalation, unintended link loss, device reset or absent bounded response
No automatic retry; restore link/device/policy and verify health
agent_execution_scope: Validate generation/policy/map and compare read-only register/link/log evidence
Do not clear errors, select target/count, change BIOS, inject/release/reset/retry or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Correct/approve generation policy and register schema
Supply exact injector/count and target mapping
Define bucket/link transition and optional management indications
Approve baseline handling, recovery/restoration and verdict

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Snapshot decoded bucket/counter/link state with monotonic timestamps, apply a bounded CE count threshold+approved margin to one mapped idle endpoint, capture transition/degradation and recovery, and retain raw/decoded registers plus device health without erasing prior evidence.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: No injection command or count is supplied; socket1/port2 and `(port)` are example/placeholders; `Clear error` is followed only by apparent reads; generation windows overlap at Gen2 and threshold zero makes `more than` ambiguous; Windows conflicts with dmesg; and Criteria omit the expected leaky-bucket register transition.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intended above-threshold PCIe bucket exercise is identifiable. A corrected policy matrix, explicit injector/count, mapped registers and recovery can make it executable.

review_improvement: Identifies that the central above-threshold stimulus is missing and prevents apparent register reads or ambiguous zero-threshold arithmetic from being treated as an executable test.
independent_technical_reasoning: Leaky-bucket validation requires a numerical policy, a known current link generation, an exact stimulus count and an expected decoded state transition. The source supplies none of the actual injection syntax and mixes hardcoded register examples with a `(port)` placeholder; its `clear` steps do not visibly write anything. Choosing count or target would therefore be fabrication. Because the FAE can provide the missing package and policy contract, the static review is complete as RPUC with a source conflict rather than BLOCKED.
